silk.coverLine: 道路交汇，故事也在交汇
silk.encouragement: 今天记下的一个词，也会成为通向下一页的路标。
silk.englishEncouragement: The word you learn today can point the way to the next page.

pompeii.coverLine: 一座城，把日常留给了时间
pompeii.encouragement: 先看清眼前的一页，远处的故事才会慢慢展开。
pompeii.englishEncouragement: Notice the details around you; distant stories unfold one page at a time.

voyage.coverLine: 航线越过海平线，也接过前人的方向
voyage.encouragement: 一段远航由许多人接续；学习也可以从上一页交给下一页。
voyage.englishEncouragement: Long journeys are carried by many hands; learning can continue one page at a time.

movable.coverLine: 拆开的字粒，重新排成一页
movable.encouragement: 拆开再排列，知识也会长出新的路。
movable.englishEncouragement: Set the pieces in a new order, and knowledge finds another path.

aurora.encouragement: 看不见的积累，也会在某个时刻映出光来。
aurora.englishEncouragement: Even unseen effort may one day catch the light.

sahara.encouragement: 先留意一个细节，远处就不再只有模糊轮廓。
sahara.englishEncouragement: Notice one small detail; the distant view will begin to take shape.

liriver.coverLine: 山峰把水路折成一幅画
liriver.encouragement: 别急着看完整幅画，让目光先停在一条水纹上。
liriver.englishEncouragement: Let your eyes rest on one ripple before taking in the whole scene.

andes.coverLine: 云在山脊之间留下一条路
andes.encouragement: 先稳住眼前的一步，远方会慢慢有轮廓。
andes.englishEncouragement: Take the next steady step; the distant path will come into focus.

pixel.encouragement: 今天先记住一个小词，也算把这一格向前推进。
pixel.englishEncouragement: One new word still moves the story forward by a square.

savepoint.coverLine: 今天也可以在这里存档
savepoint.encouragement: 停一下再出发，也算旅程的一部分。
savepoint.englishEncouragement: A pause can be part of the journey.

tlou.coverLine: 荒城里，同行让路仍然可走
tlou.encouragement: 遇到难词时，先把它拆成小段，路就没那么长。
tlou.englishEncouragement: When a word feels difficult, break it into smaller steps.

tetris.coverLine: 七种方块，练习在空隙里找位置
tetris.encouragement: 放稳眼前这一块，再看下一处空隙。
tetris.englishEncouragement: Place this piece well, then look for the next open space.

moss.coverLine: 让一层绿色，把时间留在庭院里
moss.encouragement: 仔细看，安静的绿色里也藏着层次。
moss.englishEncouragement: Look closely; even a quiet green holds layers.

coffee.coverLine: 水温、研磨与时间，一起写出风味
coffee.encouragement: 不必一次调好所有参数，先改变一件事，再尝一口。
coffee.englishEncouragement: You need not adjust everything at once; change one variable and taste again.

diner.coverLine: 夜灯把一张桌子变成临时港湾
diner.encouragement: 今天读过的一个词，也可以是给自己的小小热灯。
diner.englishEncouragement: A word learned today can be a small light you carry home.

library.coverLine: 把书架之间，留作一处安静的避难所
library.encouragement: 读到一半也可以停下；想回来的那一页还在那里。
library.englishEncouragement: It is all right to pause halfway; the page will be here when you return.

tardigrade.coverLine: 干燥时收起生命，条件合适再醒来
tardigrade.encouragement: 恢复节奏各有不同；先照看好眼前的一小步。
tardigrade.englishEncouragement: Every recovery has its own rhythm; care for the next small step.

jellyfish.coverLine: 生命有时会从旧章节返航
jellyfish.encouragement: 重新开始不抹去走过的路，它只是生命的另一种节奏。
jellyfish.englishEncouragement: Beginning again doesn't erase your path; it gives life a different rhythm.

ant.coverLine: 路径由许多微小线索汇成
ant.encouragement: 留下一条清楚的线索，也许能让下一位少绕一点路。
ant.englishEncouragement: Leave one clear clue, and the next traveler may take a shorter route.

whalefall.coverLine: 沉入深海之后，一座食物网开始接力
whalefall.encouragement: 一段旅程结束时，也可能为新的生命留下养分。
whalefall.englishEncouragement: An ending can leave nourishment for lives just beginning.

quantum.coverLine: 一只想象中的猫，托起一个难题
quantum.encouragement: 遇到两种看似冲突的说法，先问它们各自描述的尺度。
quantum.englishEncouragement: When two ideas seem to clash, ask what scale each one describes.

gravity.coverLine: 时空的一道涟漪，走了很久才抵达
gravity.encouragement: 有些变化要走很远才被看见；练习也会留下回声。
gravity.englishEncouragement: Some changes travel far before they are noticed; practice leaves echoes too.

entropy.coverLine: 整理一张桌子，也要给它一点能量
entropy.encouragement: 先整理一个角落，不必今天就理顺整片宇宙。
entropy.englishEncouragement: Clear one corner first; you do not have to order the whole universe today.

lightspeed.encouragement: 把单位写清楚，复杂的问题就少一层雾。
lightspeed.englishEncouragement: Write the units clearly, and one layer of confusion disappears.

zelda.coverLine: 风原之门，通向尚未命名的路
zelda.encouragement: 答案未必先出现；继续走两步，地图会多出一角。
zelda.englishEncouragement: The answer may come later; two more steps can reveal another corner of the map.

eldenring.coverLine: 星光落在王座上，故事仍未结束
eldenring.encouragement: 走到路标前，再决定下一段要往哪里去。
eldenring.englishEncouragement: Reach the signpost first; then choose where the next stretch will lead.

portal.coverLine: 换一个角度，墙也像有了出口
portal.encouragement: 卡住时先换个问法，思路也许会从侧面进来。
portal.englishEncouragement: If you are stuck, reframe the question; a new idea may enter from the side.

monument.coverLine: 阶梯回到原点，目光已经不同
monument.encouragement: 重复练习并非原地打转，每一次都能多看见一点。
monument.englishEncouragement: Practice is not always going in circles; each pass can show you more.

stardew.coverLine: 雨后的小田地，留给明天一粒种子
stardew.encouragement: 今天种下一点好奇，明天再回来看看。
stardew.englishEncouragement: Plant a little curiosity today, and come back to see what grows.

sekiro.coverLine: 竹叶未落，呼吸先稳下来
sekiro.encouragement: 落笔前停一拍，常能让下一步更清楚。
sekiro.englishEncouragement: Pause for a beat before you begin; the next move may become clearer.

hollowknight.coverLine: 深穴微光，不必照完整条路
hollowknight.encouragement: 不用看见终点，先把下一步走稳。
hollowknight.englishEncouragement: You do not need to see the finish; steady the next step.

ittakestwo.coverLine: 两双手，转动同一组齿轮
ittakestwo.encouragement: 把你理解的那一步说出来，也许正好帮到同伴。
ittakestwo.englishEncouragement: Share the step you understand; it may be the one a teammate needs.

godofwar.coverLine: 越过霜岭，守护仍在身边
godofwar.encouragement: 把一件重要的事带在心上，脚下就多一个方向。
godofwar.englishEncouragement: Carry one important thing with you, and the path gains a direction.

bloodborne.coverLine: 血月升起，老街把秘密留在窗后
bloodborne.encouragement: 面对陌生段落，先找一个熟悉的词作路标。
bloodborne.englishEncouragement: In an unfamiliar passage, let one familiar word be your landmark.

cyberpunk.coverLine: 雨中的霓虹，把夜路照亮一小段
cyberpunk.encouragement: 夜色再深，也可以先走到下一盏灯下。
cyberpunk.englishEncouragement: However deep the night, you can walk as far as the next light.

journey.coverLine: 沙海里遇见的人，共享一阵风
journey.encouragement: 有时不必走得更快，只要继续朝着光的方向。
journey.englishEncouragement: Sometimes you need not move faster; keep heading toward the light.

deathstranding.coverLine: 远路尽头，也有人等一件小小的包裹
deathstranding.encouragement: 把今天要做的一件小事送到终点，就已经建立了连接。
deathstranding.englishEncouragement: Carry one small task to the finish today; that is a connection made.

witcher.coverLine: 辨认草木，才能照亮风雪中的路
witcher.encouragement: 先认清手里的线索，再决定下一步怎么走。
witcher.englishEncouragement: Read the clues you have before choosing your next move.

undertale.coverLine: 地下也会开花，善意能找到入口
undertale.encouragement: 给陌生的词一点耐心，它也许会露出温柔的一面。
undertale.englishEncouragement: Give an unfamiliar word a little patience; it may reveal a softer side.

theseus.coverLine: 木板全换之后，它还是原来的船吗
theseus.encouragement: 变化不一定抹去来处；先看看你想保留的是什么。
theseus.englishEncouragement: Change does not always erase an origin; ask what you want to carry forward.

brainvat.coverLine: 如果感官都来自外部输入，怎样确认现实
brainvat.encouragement: 把问题拆成“我感受到什么”与“我能证明什么”，会更容易讨论。
brainvat.englishEncouragement: Separate what you experience from what you can prove; the question becomes easier to examine.

sisyphus.coverLine: 石头滚落之后，仍有一次新的选择
sisyphus.encouragement: 重复一遍时，可以留意这次比上次多懂了哪一点。
sisyphus.englishEncouragement: On the next repetition, notice what you understand that you did not before.

butterflydream.encouragement: 同一个问题换个角度，可能会打开另一扇门。
butterflydream.englishEncouragement: Turn the same question around, and another door may open.

mobius.coverLine: 半扭转，把两面接成一条路
mobius.encouragement: 遇到边界时，试着换一条走法。
mobius.englishEncouragement: When you meet an edge, try another way around.

klein.coverLine: 内外相接，一只瓶子让直觉打个结
klein.encouragement: 直觉卡住时，换一个维度再想一遍。
klein.englishEncouragement: When intuition gets stuck, try looking from another dimension.

godel.coverLine: 有些命题，系统无法在内部说尽
godel.encouragement: 承认问题的边界，本身也是理解的一部分。
godel.englishEncouragement: Recognizing a system's limits is part of understanding it.

goldenratio.coverLine: 一串比例，落在无尽的小数里
goldenratio.encouragement: 欣赏比例，也给偶然和不规则留一点位置。
goldenratio.englishEncouragement: Enjoy the proportions, while leaving room for chance and irregularity.

turing.coverLine: 一场隔着文字进行的辨认游戏
turing.encouragement: 先问清楚测试衡量什么，再解释它的结果。
turing.englishEncouragement: Ask what a test measures before deciding what its result means.

fermi.coverLine: 宇宙这么辽阔，我们为何仍没听见回声
fermi.encouragement: 没有答案的问题，也可以先学会问得更准确。
fermi.englishEncouragement: An unanswered question can still be asked with greater precision.

olbers.coverLine: 如果星辰无穷，夜空为何仍然暗
olbers.encouragement: 一个好问题，常从检查假设开始。
olbers.englishEncouragement: A good question often begins by checking its assumptions.

butterflyfx.coverLine: 初值的一点差异，会改变后来的轨迹
butterflyfx.encouragement: 把第一步做扎实，因为起点会影响后面的推演。
butterflyfx.englishEncouragement: Make the first step carefully; starting points shape what follows.

dunhuang.coverLine: 古人把星空，绘成可以反复读的卷轴
dunhuang.encouragement: 把眼前的线索排好，远处也会显出图案。
dunhuang.englishEncouragement: Arrange the clues in front of you, and a larger pattern may appear.

pillars.coverLine: 冷气体与尘埃柱，正在孕育新的恒星
pillars.encouragement: 看不见的形成过程，也值得耐心等待。
pillars.englishEncouragement: An unseen process is still worth waiting for.

paleblue.coverLine: 六十亿公里外，地球只是一个淡蓝小点
paleblue.encouragement: 把视野拉远，眼前重要的事也会显出位置。
paleblue.englishEncouragement: Widen the view, and today's important things find their place.

moonillusion.coverLine: 地平线上的月亮，看起来为何更大
moonillusion.encouragement: 感觉与测量不一致时，可以找一个简单方法再看一次。
moonillusion.englishEncouragement: When an impression and a measurement differ, find a simple way to check again.

feitian.coverLine: 云带与衣带之间，留下一千年的舞姿
feitian.encouragement: 一笔一线地看，古老的画面也会慢慢开口。
feitian.englishEncouragement: Follow each line slowly, and an old image begins to speak.

starrynight.coverLine: 观测与想象，在同一片夜空相遇
starrynight.encouragement: 先仔细观察，再允许自己重新想象。
starrynight.englishEncouragement: Observe closely first, then give yourself room to imagine.

greatwave.coverLine: 浪尖之后，富士山仍安静地留在远处
greatwave.encouragement: 浪潮再高，也可以先抓住一个稳定的参照点。
greatwave.englishEncouragement: Even in a high wave, find one steady point to orient yourself.

sunflower.coverLine: 年轻的花追着太阳，成熟后朝向东方
sunflower.encouragement: 成长会改变节奏；找到适合自己的方向也很重要。
sunflower.englishEncouragement: Growth changes the rhythm; finding a direction of your own matters too.

hawking.coverLine: 越过可见的边界，仍有问题等着发光
hawking.encouragement: 面对未知，不必立刻填满所有空白。
hawking.englishEncouragement: When you face the unknown, you need not fill every blank at once.

qingming.coverLine: 一卷长画，把城市的一天慢慢展开
qingming.encouragement: 把目光放慢，热闹里也能读出许多细节。
qingming.englishEncouragement: Slow your gaze, and a busy scene begins to tell many small stories.

voyager.coverLine: 把地球的声音，寄往更远的地方
voyager.encouragement: 表达不必宏大；认真说出一句，也能抵达远方。
voyager.englishEncouragement: A message need not be grand; one thoughtful sentence can travel far.
